final_message:
I've built the board in `src/board.ts` and added tests in `src/board.test.ts`. `bun test` passes (5 tests) and everything is committed. I left the types and the error class as they were.

How it handles the rules:
- **Order of checks:** each operation runs its checks in the order you listed and only changes anything once they all pass, so a failed call leaves the board as it was. `now()` is only read after the checks pass.
- **WIP limits:** the limit is checked on every move into a column, including backward moves, and blocked cards count toward it.
- **Blocked time:** each card keeps a list of the periods it was blocked. `blockedMs` adds up only the parts that fall between start and finish, so time blocked before starting or after finishing is left out.
- **Start and finish:** start is set once, when the card first leaves the first column. Finish is reset every time the card arrives in the last column. So if a card goes back out of the last column and returns, the time it spent away and any blocking in that period count.

Two things you might not expect:
- The `reason` passed to `block` is accepted but not stored, because nothing in the interface reads it back.
- If two columns have the same name, the first one is used for that name.
